mixedDecks.limits: Eight bounded games with swapped seats/decks. Unfinished games do not count as wins; these checks do not establish superiority over Hard or tournament-level strength.

priorHarnessRepairs: Inherited BW inspector assertion now checks accessible Ability label rather than overlay text.
Realistic native cleanup restores the exact prior saved workspace instead of reserializing an older fixture.
Mixed-deck replay comparisons exclude wall-clock log timestamps and compare gameplay zones, IDs, RNG, prompts, turn and winner. Raw earlier failing reports are historical evidence.
publication: Local Windows and Android packages only; no GitHub publication; no subagents.
